source_cn:
3月4日：翻完了前三十六任的全部维护日志，没有发现任何异常。但那一夜它确实出了问题。答案不在日志里。那答案在哪里？

3月11日：典籍里关于知识皇冠的记载只有只言片语——为什么这么少？是被删掉了吗？谁删的？必须找到更原始的文本。

3月19日：十一本。还差一本。

3月26日：不能停。停下来就会，就会？不能停。

4月2日：它就在某个地方。找到它找到它找到它——

4月3日：一定要找到它。

（后面还有很多页，但字迹越来越潦草，到最后已经很难辨认。）
ref_en:
March 4: Finished reading all the maintenance logs of the first 36 predecessors, found no abnormalities. But it really did have a problem that night. The answer is not in the logs. Where is the answer?

March 11: The records in the classics about the Crown of Knowledge are only fragments—why so few? Was it deleted? Who deleted it? Must find more primitive texts.

March 19: Eleven books. Still missing one.

March 26: Cannot stop. If I stop, I will, I will? Cannot stop.

April 2: It is somewhere. Find it find it find it—

April 3: Must find it.

(There are many pages behind, but the handwriting is getting more and more illegible, and it is hard to recognize by the end.)

source_cn:
嘿，我亲爱的玩家！
　　既然你要和“国王”玩选择游戏，不了解规则可不行。所以我亲自为你编写了这份终极傻瓜……哦不，是《终极扑克速成指南》！

　　<Letter_Highlight>五条</>：五张完全一样的扑克。

　　<Letter_Highlight>顺子</>：数字连续的五张扑克。

　　<Letter_Highlight>同花</>：花色相同的五张扑克。

　　<Letter_Highlight>同花顺</>：花色相同，且数字连续的五张扑克。

　　祝你好运……或者，祝你能看穿“好运”背后的把戏！
ref_en:
Hey, my dear player!
　　Since you are going to play a choice game with the "King", you can't do it without knowing the rules. So I personally wrote this ultimate dummy... oh no, it's the "Ultimate Poker Quick Guide" for you!

　　<Letter_Highlight>Five of a Kind</>: Five identical poker cards.

　　<Letter_Highlight>Straight</>: Five poker cards with consecutive numbers.

　　<Letter_Highlight>Flush</>: Five poker cards of the same suit.

　　<Letter_Highlight>Straight Flush</>: Five poker cards of the same suit and consecutive numbers.

　　Good luck... or, I hope you can see through the tricks behind "good luck"!

source_cn:
%s:
      我听闻你与异化猎犬遭遇了一场苦战。不必过分担忧。在过去的岁月循环中，我已经明白失败与胜利——乃至生存与死亡——都不过是一时的、相对的：它只是你旅途中的一个普通坐标，用来验证你的成长。谨记面对异化猎犬的诀窍：<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302115">异化猎犬的记载</>
      对于一位总在路上的旅人来说，我知道让人停下脚步的常常并非挫折本身，而是失去了再次上路的勇气。所幸你并不胆怯于面对更多新冒险，我想下次，我听到的就会是更好的消息。对你这样年轻的非凡者而言，你已经做得很好。
      如果你需要的话，漫长的时光为我积淀下一些经验，也许对你有用。<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">点此查看</>
ref_en:
%s:
      I heard that you encountered a bitter battle with the Alienated Hound. Do not worry too much. In the cycles of time past, I have come to understand that failure and victory—and even life and death—are merely temporary and relative: they are just ordinary coordinates on your journey, used to verify your growth. Keep in mind the tips for facing the Alienated Hound: <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302115">Records of the Alienated Hound</>
      For a traveler who is always on the road, I know that what makes people stop is often not the setback itself, but the loss of courage to set off again. Fortunately, you are not timid about facing new adventures, and I think next time, the news I hear will be better. For a young Beyonder like you, you have already done very well. 
      If you need it, the long passage of time has accumulated some experience for me that might be useful to you. <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">Click here to view</>

ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Gift Money - Gold Pound Gift Money】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Opening Level: </>Cognition Level <Assistant_Red>2</>
<Assistant_Title2>System Entry: </>In <Assistant_System>Chat - bottom right of the corresponding channel - Gift Money button</>, you can distribute gift money in different channels.
<Assistant_Title2>Distribution Channels: </>You can distribute corresponding Gold Pound gift money in Team/Group channels, Club channels, and voice rooms.
<Assistant_Title2>Broadcast Gift Money: </>Use Heart Feather Oracle Broadcast and Lightning Oracle Broadcast to send server-wide marquee broadcasts, with half the value of Bound Gold Pound gift money for the World channel attached.
<Assistant_Title2>Gift Money Consumption: </>Consuming non-bound Gold Pounds allows you to send Bound Gold Pound gift money; claiming gift money grants equivalent Bound Gold Pounds. 24 hours after Bound Gold Pound gift money is sent, unclaimed gift money will be returned as equivalent Bound Gold Pounds.

<Assistant_Title2>Whisper Gift Money: </>Requires voice input of the correct whisper to claim the gift money, and after claiming, you will receive a random amount of Bound Gold Pound rewards.
<Assistant_Title2>Key Gift Money: </>Requires entering the correct password to claim the gift money, and after claiming, you will receive a random amount of Bound Gold Pound rewards.

source_cn:
嘿，我亲爱的玩家！
　　既然你要和“国王”玩选择游戏，不了解规则可不行。所以我亲自为你编写了这份终极傻瓜……哦不，是《终极扑克速成指南》！

　　<Letter_Highlight>五条</>：五张完全一样的扑克。

　　<Letter_Highlight>顺子</>：数字连续的五张扑克。

　　<Letter_Highlight>同花</>：花色相同的五张扑克。

　　<Letter_Highlight>同花顺</>：花色相同，且数字连续的五张扑克。

　　祝你好运……或者，祝你能看穿“好运”背后的把戏！
ref_en:
Hey, my dear player! 
　　Since you want to play a choice game with the 'King', you can't do it without knowing the rules. So I personally wrote this ultimate dummy... oh no, the 'Ultimate Poker Crash Course'! 

　　<Letter_Highlight> Five of a Kind </>: Five identical poker cards. 

　　<Letter_Highlight> Straight </>: Five poker cards with consecutive numbers. 

　　<Letter_Highlight> Flush </>: Five poker cards of the same suit. 

　　<Letter_Highlight> Straight Flush </>: Five poker cards of the same suit with consecutive numbers. 

　　Good luck... or, I hope you can see through the tricks behind 'good luck'!

伦纳德玩世不恭般地笑笑道：“克莱恩，我们之间不需要假装，我目睹过你摆脱封印物‘2-049’的控制，知道你的特殊，而你也应该模糊感觉得出来我和一般非凡者不同。”
　　他收敛笑容，迎着克莱恩的目光道：
　　“我曾经对你说过，这个世界上有很多特殊的人，总是能做到别人做不到的事情，比如说你，也比如说我。”
　　“这个世界拥有漫长的历史，存在这样或者那样的神奇物品，总会有人得到它们，掌握它们，成为不同戏剧的主角，这样的人不会太多，但肯定不可能只有那么一两位。”

　　——第一卷《小丑》第一百二十一章 伦纳德的“猜测”
ref_en:
Leonard smiled cynically and said, "Klein, there's no need for us to pretend. I witnessed you break free from the control of the mystical item '2-049', so I know you're special. You should also be able to vaguely sense that I'm different from the average Beyonder."
 He reined in his smile and, meeting Klein's gaze, said:
 "I once told you that there are many special people in this world who can always do things others cannot—like you, and like me."

<Assistant_Title1>装备重塑</>

<Assistant_Title2>玩法说明：</>

1、当前赛季中，武器、护甲、胸针、帽子部位将依次解锁词条重塑功能。解锁后，可消耗蓝山晶石对装备进行重塑，获得随机的装备词条。

2、未解锁重塑的部位，仍可进行词条保存和应用。例如：通过玩法获得带有2条非凡词条的指环时，该词条组合将自动保存，可在重塑界面右侧的“恩赐”中应用到任意指环。

<Assistant_Title2>道具获取：</>可通过分解装备、报销商店兑换等方式获取蓝山晶石。
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1> Equipment Reshaping </>

<Assistant_Title2> Gameplay Description: </>

 1. In the current season, the Weapon, Armor, Brooch, and Hat slots will unlock the affix reshaping function sequentially. Once unlocked, you can consume Blue Mountain Crystals to reshape equipment and obtain random equipment affixes. 

 2. Slots that have not unlocked reshaping can still have their affixes saved and applied. For example, when obtaining a ring with 2 Extraordinary affixes through gameplay, the combination is automatically saved and can be applied to any ring via the "Gift" section on the right of the Reshape interface.

source_cn:
“审判官”带我见了个人。穿着黑袍，说话像机器，自称是“蒸汽与机械之神教会”的使徒。他说非凡力量是通往更高存在的阶梯，只要我愿意，他可以帮我踏入非凡。为了向我展示这一点，他们当着我的面让一个瘦子变成了狼人！真是一群疯子。
　　我问他，需要付出什么。
　　他说，忠诚。
　　我心里骂了他十遍。我只忠诚于廷根。但我没说出口。我需要他的力量，等我变强了，谁忠诚谁还不一定。
　　但狼人也太他妈丑了，“通识者”也许不错。
ref_en:
The "Inquisitor" brought me to meet someone. He was wearing a black robe, spoke like a machine, and claimed to be an Apostle of the God of Steam and Machinery. He said that Beyonder power is a ladder to a higher existence, and as long as I am willing, he can help me step into the extraordinary. To show me this, they turned a skinny man into a werewolf right in front of me! They are truly a bunch of madmen. 
 I asked him what I needed to pay. 
 He said, loyalty. 
 I cursed him ten times in my heart. I am only loyal to Tingen. But I didn't say it out loud. I need his power; once I become stronger, it's not certain who will be loyal to whom. 
 But the werewolf is also too damn ugly; "Savants" might be good.

In the permanent befriending event within the <Assistant_System>Menu - Connections - Befriend Connections</> interface, click the Wish button at the bottom left of the video to enter the Wish interface.

匹配成功后，两位非凡者会组成为期7天的临时誓约。
活动期间内，七日誓约对象享受额外20%的誓约值加成。
活动期间，两位誓约者可直接发起与誓约对象的转正，转为正式誓约。
活动期间，如果有人发起单人解契，需要缴纳少量绑定苏勒才可解契，如果双人解契，则不用缴纳绑定苏勒。
活动结束3天后，如果非凡者没有转正，七日誓约会自动解散。
ref_en:
Beyonders can sign up for the Seven-Day Covenant event.
After registration ends, a Covenant partner will be randomly matched for each Beyonder (the higher your login days in the 5 days prior to registration, the easier it is to find a match).
Once matched, the two Beyonders will form a temporary Covenant for 7 days.
During the event, Seven-Day Covenant partners enjoy an additional 20% Covenant Point bonus.
During the event, the two partners can directly initiate a transition to a formal Covenant.
During the event, if someone initiates a solo dissolution, a small amount of bound soli must be paid to dissolve the Covenant; if both parties dissolve it together, no bound soli is required.
3 days after the event ends, if the Beyonders have not transitioned to a formal Covenant, the Seven-Day Covenant will automatically dissolve.

source_cn:
在因蒂斯的街头巷尾，流传着这么一个传说。
有位年轻貌美的青年，可以扮演世界上最好的情人。他会在半夜踏着一双刷得发亮的皮靴，攀上寂寞男女的窗台，递上一支鲜红的蔷薇。如果对方收下了花朵，那么他将应邀入内，将一个美好夜晚献给蔷薇的新主人。
不过在蒸汽教会逮捕了当事人后，其貌不扬的男子坦白道：这双皮靴确实会让收到自己所赠物品的人暂时无法反抗，便于让自己行窃。不过相对的，穿着皮靴时，他会失去一切身为男性的欲望。
至于为什么传说会变成这样，也许是因为……这就是因蒂斯吧。
ref_en:
In the streets and alleys of Intis, such a legend circulates. 
 There is a young and handsome youth who can act as the world's best lover. In the middle of the night, he would step in a pair of polished leather boots, climb onto the windowsill of lonely men or women, and hand over a bright red rose. If the other party accepted the flower, he would be invited inside to dedicate a wonderful night to the rose's new owner. 
 However, after the Church of Steam arrested the person in question, the unremarkable man confessed: these leather boots do indeed make those who receive his gifts temporarily unable to resist, making it easier for him to commit theft. But conversely, while wearing the boots, he loses all desire as a man. 
 As for why the legend became what it is, perhaps because... this is Intis.

ref_en:
Ms. Wall says that a true writer must be a recorder, delving into the most realistic scenes to personally feel the scent of the story.
	What's a snow monster? I am going to write the most shocking legend of hunting giant beasts!

	Wait, why are those groups of explorers fighting? Was that a gunshot?
	Oh my god, what treasure are they fighting over? This is much more exciting than my original plan!
	I've decided, I'm not writing about any snow monster giant beasts. I'll write "Snowy Mountain Shootout" when I get back!
	Wait, why are they coming towards me?

source_cn:
“这份尸检报告相当完美，尤其是示意图的绘制……弗莱，听说你曾经想成为一位画家?”层层叠叠的卷宗后，戴莉微笑着抬头，看向面前青年沉默而苍白的面容。

      “是的，戴莉女士。”弗莱略带意外地回答：“这的确对现在的工作有一定帮助。”
      “在听说你会被调去贝克兰德后，弗莱就一直在学习，直到能顺利接手这部分事务。”房门被推开，邓恩握着一份文件走了进来。
      他看向二人的目光深邃而温和：“你可以放心了，戴莉——以及，你的正式调令到了。”

      文件在苦涩的咖啡香气中展开，戴莉将它接过，目光却在邓恩和弗莱身上来回流转，直到露出一个不带任何轻佻的微笑。
      “我一直都很放心，毕竟在我之前和在我之后，都有那么可靠的守护者。”
ref_en:
"This autopsy report is quite perfect, especially the drawing of the schematic... Frye, I heard you once wanted to be a painter?" Behind layers of files, Daly looked up with a smile at the silent, pale face of the young man before her.

      "Yes, Ms. Daly." Frye answered with slight surprise: "It does indeed help with my current work to some extent."
      "Ever since he heard he would be transferred to Backlund, Frye has been studying until he could smoothly take over this part of the affairs." The door was pushed open, and Dunn walked in holding a document.
      His gaze toward the two was deep and gentle: "You can rest easy, Daly—and, your official transfer order has arrived."

      The document was unfolded amidst the bitter aroma of coffee. Daly took it, but her gaze wandered between Dunn and Frye until she revealed a smile without any hint of frivolity.
      "I have always been at ease, after all, both before me and after me, there have been such reliable Guardians."

<InvDefault_HW>一天，戴莉发现邓恩从地上捡起来什么东西，固定在角上后它发现是自己掉落的羽毛。</>

　　<InvDefault_HW>“这些羽毛太美了，我舍不得它们就这样被遗忘。”邓恩甩了甩头，“即使我明天就会忘记为什么要这么做，但我的角会记得这种发痒的感觉。”</>

ref_en:
<InvDefault_HW>One day, Daly discovered that Dunn had picked something up from the ground and fixed it to its antlers; it realized it was one of its own fallen feathers.</>

　　<InvDefault_HW>"These feathers are too beautiful; I can't bear for them to be forgotten just like that." Dunn shook its head, "Even if I forget why I did this tomorrow, my antlers will remember this itching sensation."</>

　　<InvDefault_HW>Daly's heart trembled gently. She fluttered excitedly between Dunn's two antlers, preparing to show off her voice and shake off a few brand-new feathers. Dunn stopped her from doing something that would make her even colder and asked her to help organize the collected feathers. Daly hung them together with the wooden plaques, letting them collide in the wind and snow, composing the forest's melody along with the sound of deer hooves and birdsong.</>

source_cn:
奥黛丽·霍尔，一颗足以照亮整个时代的宝石。
她的智慧，她的美貌，她的品格，她的礼仪，都无可挑剔。

善良，于她而言，从不意味着一腔热泪的挥洒，而是洞察之后清醒的选择。运用贵族的影响力，她在错综复杂的世界棋盘中，为一枚枚卒子争取喘息之机。
正义，于她而言，并非手持天秤的冰冷女神，而是诊断社会病灶的敏锐，开具疗愈处方的智慧，是她在末日来临前狂风巨浪中，为心灵提供一方稳定甲板的勇敢。

她的善良，是看清生活本质后，依旧热爱自己的家人。她的正义，是深知黑暗后，依旧织补人性的梦网。以凡人之心灵，驾驭神明之权柄；以不泯的善意，锚定观众的视角。

“我凝视深渊，亦凝视深渊中每一种心灵。
不使自己坠落，亦不使凝视沦为冷漠。
我是观众，亦在剧中——
在命运的舞台灯光之外，
为所有应当美好的情节，
守住一盏永不挪移的、温暖而清醒的灯。”
ref_en:
Audrey Hall, a gem capable of illuminating an entire era. 
 Her wisdom, her beauty, her character, and her etiquette are all impeccable. 

 Kindness, to her, never meant the shedding of hot tears, but a clear choice after insight. Using the influence of the nobility, she strives for breathing room for every pawn on the complex chessboard of the world. 
 Justice, to her, is not a cold goddess holding scales, but the keenness to diagnose social ills, the wisdom to prescribe healing, and the courage to provide a stable deck for the soul amidst the raging storms before the apocalypse. 

 Her kindness is to still love her family after seeing the essence of life. Her justice is to still weave the dream net of humanity after knowing the darkness. With a mortal heart, she wields the authority of a god; with unextinguished goodwill, she anchors the perspective of a Spectator. 

 "I gaze into the abyss, and I also gaze into every kind of soul within the abyss. 
 Not letting myself fall, nor letting the gaze turn into indifference. 
 I am a Spectator, and I am also in the play—
 Outside the stage lights of fate, 
 For all the plots that should be beautiful, 
 Guarding a warm and clear lamp that never moves."

source_cn: <Highlight>黑夜女神教会</>，建立于第三纪，第四纪联合帝国时期成为正统教会，其成员信仰黑夜女神，与战神教会水火不容。教会总部为宁静教堂，俗称“圣堂”，位于北部凛冬郡。\n 组织架构：教宗为地上天使，是黑夜女神的眷者，执掌教会。教宗之下是十三位大主教与九位高级执事，其中接近一半达到半神层次，其他也是得到圣物承认的序列5非凡者。在地位层面是完全平等的，只遵循黑夜女神的神谕，只对教宗负责。再下面是各教区主教和值夜者执事，晋升为序列5即足以担任。
ref_en: <Highlight>Church of the Evernight Goddess</>, established in the Third Epoch, became the orthodox church during the United Empire period of the Fourth Epoch. Its members worship the Evernight Goddess and are at odds with the Church of the God of Combat. The church headquarters is the Saint Samuel Cathedral, commonly known as the 'Holy Cathedral', located in the northern Winter County. \n Organizational structure: The Pope is an angel on earth, a Blessed of the Evernight Goddess, who governs the church. Below the Pope are thirteen Archbishops and nine High Deacons, nearly half of whom have reached the demigod level, while others are Sequence 5 Beyonders recognized by holy artifacts. They are completely equal in status, follow only the oracles of the Evernight Goddess, and are only responsible to the Pope. Below them are the bishops of each diocese and the Nighthawk deacons; advancing to Sequence 5 is sufficient to serve as one.

source_cn:
<Assistant_Title1>【如何对其他玩家进行安魂】</>
<Assistant_Title2>操作步骤：</>
1. 点击打开<Assistant_System>灵视</>，查看周围玩家的理智值状态，不同理智值的玩家会有不同的颜色表现。
2. 在灵视状态下，点击目标玩家，查看其当前理智值状态。
3. 若目标玩家可以进行安魂，会显示<Assistant_System>安魂按钮</>。
4. 点击<Assistant_System>安魂按钮</>后，即可对其进行安魂。

<Assistant_Title2>图文引导：</>不会操作？{JumpToUI:[点这里查看图文引导]|1302511}

ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【How to Perform Requiem on Other Players】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Steps:</>
1. Click to open <Assistant_System>Spirit Vision</> to view the sanity status of surrounding players; players with different sanity levels will have different color indicators.
2. In Spirit Vision mode, click on the target player to view their current sanity status.
3. If the target player can be subjected to Requiem, the <Assistant_System>Requiem button</> will be displayed.
4. Click the <Assistant_System>Requiem button</> to perform Requiem on them.

 Utopia Theater has recently experienced abnormal fluctuations. The power of an Outer Deity has permeated reality, corrupting the residual consciousness of some marionettes within the theater. These corrupted marionettes are attempting to establish a hidden channel to the Fool's spirit through memory items related to Klein. Once successful, the Mother Goddess will have the ability to influence the Fool's spirit, affecting the entire Southern Continent. The Church needs someone to enter the former town of Utopia, clear out the out-of-control marionettes, investigate the remaining memories, and ultimately cut off the source of the corruption.

We whisper together
Quiet and meaningless
As wind over dry grass

With direct eyes, to death's other Kingdom

source_cn:
%s:
      我听闻你与子爵夫人遭遇了一场苦战。不必过分担忧。在过去的岁月循环中，我已经明白失败与胜利——乃至生存与死亡——都不过是一时的、相对的：它只是你旅途中的一个普通坐标，用来验证你的成长。谨记面对子爵夫人的诀窍：<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302120">子爵夫人的记载</>
      对于一位总在路上的旅人来说，我知道让人停下脚步的常常并非挫折本身，而是失去了再次上路的勇气。所幸你并不胆怯于面对更多新冒险，我想下次，我听到的就会是更好的消息。对你这样年轻的非凡者而言，你已经做得很好。
      如果你需要的话，漫长的时光为我积淀下一些经验，也许对你有用。<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">点此查看</>
ref_en:
%s:
      I heard that you encountered a bitter battle with the Viscountess. Do not worry too much. In the cycles of time past, I have come to understand that failure and victory—and even life and death—are merely temporary and relative: they are just ordinary coordinates on your journey, used to verify your growth. Keep in mind the tips for facing the Viscountess: <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302120">Records of the Viscountess</>
      For a traveler who is always on the road, I know that what makes people stop is often not the setback itself, but the loss of courage to set off again. Fortunately, you are not timid about facing new adventures, and I think next time, the news I hear will be better. For a young Beyonder like you, you have already done very well. 
      If you need it, the long passage of time has accumulated some experience for me that might be useful to you. <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">Click here to view</>

歌剧魅影是俱乐部之间比拼时装搭配的大型比赛活动，每周准时举行。
歌剧魅影共分为四个阶段。
搭配阶段：每周指定时间后，公布本周的时装搭配主题，需要根据对应主题，搭配高分的时装搭配组合
调整阶段：搭配阶段结束后，俱乐部搭配总评前五名会被选入比赛，会长/副会长可以调整出战顺序，利用策略击败对手
比赛阶段：调整阶段结束后，比赛将会在歌剧魅影舞台开始，场地内会开启一场盛大的表演，决出俱乐部的胜负
休整阶段：比赛结束后，直到下次搭配阶段开始前，歌剧魅影会处于休整阶段

每一轮歌剧魅影分为三小场，决出小组内的最强俱乐部，三场均完成后会进行升降级。
歌剧魅影使用的赛区会和四方联赛保持一致，但进行独立的升降级

ref_en:
Phantom of the Opera is a large-scale competition event where Clubs compete in fashion coordination, held punctually every week. 
Phantom of the Opera is divided into four stages.
Coordination Stage: After the designated time each week, the fashion coordination theme for the week is announced. You need to coordinate a high-scoring fashion combination based on the corresponding theme.
Adjustment Stage: After the coordination stage ends, the top five Club coordination overall rankings will be selected for the competition. The President/Vice-President can adjust the battle order to use strategy to defeat opponents.
Competition Stage: After the adjustment stage ends, the competition will begin on the Phantom of the Opera stage. A grand performance will take place in the venue to determine the Club's victory or defeat.
Rest Stage: After the competition ends, until the next coordination stage begins, Phantom of the Opera will be in the rest stage.

Each round of Phantom of the Opera is divided into three sub-matches to determine the strongest Club in the group. After all three matches are completed, promotions and relegations will occur.
The competition zones used for Phantom of the Opera will be consistent with the Four-Way League, but will have independent promotion and relegation.

Specific competition times (excluding the first match after server launch):
First Match:
Coordination Opens: Thursday 10:00
Adjustment Opens: Friday 19:30
Competition Opens: Friday 20:00
Second Match:
Coordination Opens: Monday 10:00
Adjustment Opens: Wednesday 19:30
Competition Opens: Wednesday 20:00
Third Match:
Coordination Opens: Thursday 10:00
Adjustment Opens: Friday 19:30
Competition Opens: Friday 20:00

source_cn:
阿兹克将那只手套递给克莱恩时，他看见掌心裂开了一张嘴，白森森的牙齿在虚空中咬合。
“它很强大，”阿兹克说，“但每次使用后，必须用一个活人的灵魂和血肉喂饱它。”
克莱恩接过手套，感到一股永远无法填平的饥饿。
那天晚上，他写下誓言：“我只放牧罪孽深重之人，我承诺让原本放牧的灵魂得到解脱。”
从那以后，格尔曼·斯帕罗的名字开始在海上流传——那个戴着人皮手套的疯狂冒险家，专门猎杀海盗、奴隶贩子和罪犯。
他解放原本囚禁的可怜灵魂，放牧曾犯下血债的罪孽之人。
后来，手套在迷雾小镇与A先生融合，开始在克莱恩的脑海中赞美真实造物主。
“早中晚各一次，”克莱恩拿出一把蘑菇，冷静地说，“赞颂前必须预先提醒。”
手套剧烈颤抖——它从未想过，有一天会被蘑菇威胁。
“成交。”
从此，格尔曼·斯帕罗的口袋里总是装着几颗蘑菇。
ref_en:
When Azik handed that glove to Klein, he saw a mouth split open in the palm, white teeth biting in the void. 
 "It is very powerful," Azik said, "but after every use, it must be fed with the soul and flesh of a living person." 
 Klein took the glove and felt a hunger that could never be satisfied. 
 That night, he wrote a vow: "I will only shepherd those who have committed grave sins; I promise to let the souls I shepherd find release." 
 From then on, the name Gehrman Sparrow began to spread on the sea—the crazy adventurer wearing human-skin gloves who specialized in hunting pirates, slave traders, and criminals. 
 He liberated the poor souls that were originally imprisoned and shepherded the sinners who had committed blood debts. 
 Later, the glove fused with Mr. A in the Fog Town and began to praise the True Creator in Klein's mind. 
 "Once in the morning, noon, and night," Klein took out a mushroom and said calmly, "you must give a warning before praising." 
 The glove trembled violently—it had never imagined that one day it would be threatened by a mushroom. 
 "Deal." 
 From then on, Gehrman Sparrow's pocket was always filled with a few mushrooms.

source_cn:
5月23日
　　尼尔说这条路他走过七次。
　　一路上他说了三遍，我不信——如果他真的走过七次，为什么连帐篷都不会搭？我蹲在他身后，看他第三次把帐篷布穿反，雪水渗进手套，冷得像在舔我的骨头。
　　万幸，我们在天黑前支起了帐篷。

剩余物资：
面包6份    佩姬为我们准备了18磅分成了8份
肉干和肉肠5份
糖1罐
黄油4块
酒3瓶      酒3瓶 → 2瓶（晚上庆祝消耗1瓶）
水5瓶      暂时充足，路上可以留意水源
ref_en:
May 23rd
　　Neil said he has walked this path seven times.
　　He said it three times along the way, but I don't believe it—if he really had walked it seven times, why wouldn't he even know how to set up a tent? I crouched behind him, watching him put the tent fabric on backward for the third time. Snow water seeped into my gloves, cold as if it were licking my bones.
　　Fortunately, we set up the tent before dark.

Remaining supplies:
Bread: 6 portions (Peggy prepared 18 lbs for us, divided into 8 portions)
Dried meat and sausages: 5 portions
Sugar: 1 jar
Butter: 4 blocks
Wine: 3 bottles (Wine: 3 bottles → 2 bottles (1 consumed for the evening celebration))
Water: 5 bottles (Temporarily sufficient; can keep an eye out for water sources on the way)

塔罗学派必读榜前五的优秀作品，贝尔纳黛会长倾心推荐！

　　《赞美太阳》“赞美太阳”不应流于表面，而该发自内心。
　　《海上八万里》一本讲述海上生活的小说，书籍粉丝常因为作者是真水手还是假水手争论不休。
　　《秘密的秘密》一本加入了神秘学元素的侦探小说，其开放式结局引发了巨大的争议。
　　《学会看书》白塔途径学员的必修书目，同时是塔罗学派最热门的通识书籍。
ref_en:
Top five excellent works on the Tarot Club's must-read list, highly recommended by President Bernadette!
　　"Self-Cultivation of a Spectator" is said to have been compiled under the guidance of a demigod-level mentor in the Spectator pathway.
　　"Praise the Sun": "Praise the Sun" should not be superficial, but should come from the heart.
　　"Eighty Thousand Miles at Sea": A novel about life at sea, book fans often argue about whether the author is a real sailor or a fake sailor.
　　"Secret of Secrets": A detective novel with occult elements, its open ending has sparked huge controversy.
　　"Learning to Read": A required book for students of the White Tower pathway, and also the most popular general knowledge book of the Tarot Club.

%s:
      我听闻你与异化猎犬遭遇了一场苦战。不必过分担忧。在过去的岁月循环中，我已经明白失败与胜利——乃至生存与死亡——都不过是一时的、相对的：它只是你旅途中的一个普通坐标，用来验证你的成长。谨记面对异化猎犬的诀窍：<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302112">异化猎犬的记载</>
      对于一位总在路上的旅人来说，我知道让人停下脚步的常常并非挫折本身，而是失去了再次上路的勇气。所幸你并不胆怯于面对更多新冒险，我想下次，我听到的就会是更好的消息。对你这样年轻的非凡者而言，你已经做得很好。
      如果你需要的话，漫长的时光为我积淀下一些经验，也许对你有用。<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">点此查看</>
ref_en:
%s:
      I heard that you encountered a bitter battle with the Alienated Hound. Do not worry too much. In the cycles of time past, I have come to understand that failure and victory—and even life and death—are merely temporary and relative: they are just ordinary coordinates on your journey, used to verify your growth. Keep in mind the tips for facing the Alienated Hound: <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302112">Records of the Alienated Hound</>
      For a traveler who is always on the road, I know that what makes people stop is often not the setback itself, but the loss of courage to set off again. Fortunately, you are not timid about facing new adventures, and I think next time, the news I hear will be better. For a young Beyonder like you, you have already done very well. 
      If you need it, the long passage of time has accumulated some experience for me that might be useful to you. <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">Click here to view</>

        “你觉得‘牧羊人’洛薇雅长老有可能会对白银城造成危害吗？只用回答是或者否，不要解释。”

ref_en:
Alger asked again:
 "Do you think Shepherd Elder Lovia might pose a threat to the City of Silver? Just answer yes or no, don't explain."
 "...Yes." Derrick ultimately could not deceive himself.
 Alger chuckled and said:
 "So, you are the only one who knows about this, but you can't find a way to warn the other elders of the Six-Member Council for the time being, right?"
 "Yeah." Derrick's expression gradually became solemn.
 Alger changed his sitting posture and leaned back: "The risk of that mission is extremely high. You know this. If you die in that half-destroyed temple, who else can find a way to expose Shepherd Lovia's strangeness? Who else can save the City of Silver from disaster? The 'Fallen Creator' is a true evil god!"

source_cn:
和大多数孩子比起来，梅丽莎无疑是特别的。
她十六岁的时候，已经习惯了清晨五点半起床，步行五十分钟去廷根技术学校。不是为了锻炼，而是这样每周能省下八便士——刚好够一顿有肉的晚餐，或者让班森少加一次班。
她很少给家里添麻烦。或者说，她已经成熟到能为两个哥哥解决麻烦了。家庭的每一笔开支都经过她的计算，这要归功于她那出色的数学天赋，能把生活安排得井井有条。但这还不够，梅丽莎还要为将来打算——也许只有两个哥哥都过上稳定的生活，她才能停下来。
她喜欢研究机械。那些捡来的废旧零件，会在她手里奇迹般地变成能跑能跳的小玩意儿。咔哒咔哒的发条声里，每一枚齿轮都精准地履行着自己的职责。秩序感能抚平她心里的焦虑，让她感到前所未有的安心。
班森和克莱恩总担心她太过懂事，怕她变成一位愁容满面的严肃女士。但梅丽莎也是个可爱的孩子。别人夸她时，她嘴上说“还好”，心里却悄悄开了花。还有第一次吃到克莱恩做的羊肉时——美食对她来说太奢侈了，一个不小心，她就扫光了自己那份。然后红着脸去收拾厨具，生怕被看到那因过分幸福而藏不住的失态。
她像一枚精准运转的齿轮，把自己嵌进这个家的每个缝隙里。偶尔也会咔哒一声，偷偷快乐一下。
ref_en:
Compared to most children, Melissa is undoubtedly special. 
 By the time she was sixteen, she was already used to getting up at 5:30 in the morning and walking for fifty minutes to Tingen Technical School. Not for exercise, but to save eight pence a week—just enough for a dinner with meat, or to let Benson work one less overtime shift. 
 She rarely adds trouble to the family. Or rather, she has matured enough to solve problems for her two brothers. Every expenditure of the family is calculated by her, thanks to her excellent mathematical talent, which can arrange life in an orderly manner. But this is not enough, Melissa also has to plan for the future—perhaps only when both brothers have a stable life can she stop. 
 She likes to study mechanics. Those discarded parts she picked up would miraculously turn into gadgets that can run and jump in her hands. In the ticking sound of the clockwork, every gear performs its duty precisely. The sense of order can smooth out the anxiety in her heart, making her feel unprecedentedly at ease. 
 Benson and Klein are always worried that she is too sensible, afraid that she will become a serious lady with a worried face. But Melissa is also a cute child. When others praise her, she says “it’s okay” on the surface, but her heart is secretly blooming. And the first time she ate the mutton Klein cooked—food is too luxurious for her, and if she wasn’t careful, she would finish her share. Then she would go to clean up the kitchenware with a blushing face, for fear of being seen in a state of being unable to hide her excessive happiness. 
 She is like a precisely running gear, embedding herself into every gap in this family. Occasionally, she will click and be secretly happy.
